title: Rafael and the House
author: Rafael Ishikawa
blurb: Wren Sandoval, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
